title: GitLab: unauthenticated code execution (CVE-2026-110264)
summary: GitLab released critical patches on 21 October 2026 for CVE-2026-110264 (CVSS 10.0): an unauthenticated user could run code on a self-managed GitLab server. Affected: CE and EE from 7.0 before 18.11.13, 19.0 before 19.0.10, 19.1 before 19.1.9, 19.2 before 19.2.9, 19.3 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3 and 19.5 before 19.5.1; 18.10 and older get no patch. GitLab.com is already patched. Wardlatch reads the installed version from GitLab's own version files and never runs GitLab.

files.label: self-compiled
files.reviewWhenFixed: this version has GitLab's fix, but the fix also patches Ruby's regular-expression engine (Onigmo), which the Linux package bundles and a self-compiled install brings itself: check that your Ruby carries GitLab's patch

versionFiles.fix: Upgrade GitLab to 19.5.1, 19.4.3, 19.3.6, 19.2.9, 19.1.9, 19.0.10 or 18.11.13 (or later on the same line). 18.10 and older get no patch: upgrade to a supported line. GitLab strongly recommends upgrading immediately; its patch page has the upgrade notes.

reviewFix: Check that the Ruby your self-compiled GitLab runs on includes GitLab's Onigmo patch (see GitLab's patch release notes).
safeText: no self-managed GitLab install found on this machine (GitLab in Docker or Kubernetes isn't checked yet)
